title: hive-word complete: request body
description: The owner's disposition of an accepted answer that releases no work: the question is closed, its hold released where nothing is left for it to gate, the held item and every item beneath it each archived or a decision item as it stands. word persists it through hive-pool complete-question, as one handoff, passing on the envelope's expected_revisions. Completing a report, a review or a round never completes a question. See spec/word.md.

note.description: The owner's disposition note: its own words on the card, never the Hive Mind's.

evidence.description: What the owner did on the answer, where it names a record.
